subject: Configurable tenant geo-policy admin UI + migration plan
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sylvia Nguyen <sylvia.nguyen@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Configurable tenant geo-policy admin UI + migration plan

Hi team,

Following the Acme kickoff yesterday, Sylvia asked for a single-pane admin experience where their platform team can:
- Select per-tenant storage region (US / EU / APAC)
- Configure tenant TTLs (30/90/365/custom) tied to a retention policy
- Trigger scheduled or on-demand migrations when they change a tenant region

I've attached a draft spec (tenant_geo_policy_spec_v2.pdf) and a rough migration workbook (migration_steps.xlsx). High-level asks from Acme:
1) A simple UI in Console that maps 1:1 to backend flags we can use for routing and storage placement.
2) A zero-downtime migration path for moderate-size tenants (~500GB of historical embeddings + objects).
3) Clear audit logs and a retention preview for legal/compliance.

Can product + infra propose a minimal MVP and a recommended rollout plan (canary -> staged) we can share with Acme next week? Key constraints to call out: backup snapshot windows, expected migration throughput, and data purge guarantees once TTLs are set.

Proposed owners: Dev (migration engine), Jonas (routing/flags), Laura (Console UI), Marissa (customer rollout). If you're good with that, can each reply with:
- a rough estimate (S/M/L) for effort and any blockers
- one technical risk we need to escalate now

Thanks — I want to have a short sync Wed 3/31 to finalize the plan before the customer meeting.

—Camila
Senior Product Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: tenant_geo_policy_spec_v2.pdf (spec), migration_steps.xlsx (workbook)

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sylvia Nguyen <sylvia.nguyen@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Configurable tenant geo-policy admin UI + migration plan

Camila —

Thanks for the clear brief. Quick technical notes from infra/migration perspective:

Effort estimate: Medium-Large (depends on migration parallelism and snapshot strategy).
Technical risk (top 3):
- Cross-region snapshot consistency: we need to decide whether to do streaming copy (real-time KV replay) vs. bulk snapshot-and-copy. Streaming reduces downtime but is more complex and impacts tail latency.
- KV cache & prefix caching: we must ensure cached keys are invalidated in the new region and that we don't accidentally serve old prefixes during cutover.
- Backup retention during migration: customers want immutable recovery points for 30 days post-migration; that increases storage/IO overhead.

Questions for product:
1) For "custom TTLs" do we want to allow per-tenant cron-like rules or only preset buckets? Presets simplify enforcement & indexing.
2) Do we need an option to clone vs. move data (Acme asked about cloning a test tenant into EU before switching production)?

Suggested mitigation: start with preset TTL buckets (30/90/365 + custom with gated approval) and a bulk snapshot-copy approach for MVP with a streaming backfill option for high-SLA tenants in a later phase.

I'll attach a short rollout_flags.md with recommended runtime flags and a rough throughput calc.

—Dev
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: rollout_flags.md (recommended flags and throughput notes)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sylvia Nguyen <sylvia.nguyen@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Configurable tenant geo-policy admin UI + migration plan

Spreading a few quick implementation suggestions from routing/serving side: 

- Routing flags: add (tenant_region, tenant_ttl_bucket, migration_state) to the tenant metadata. Keep migration_state as {idle, copying, cutover, verifying}. This allows runtime routing to fallback to the original region while copying.
- Canary plan: pick 3 low-traffic tenants for an internal canary, then 5 incremental customer tenants (week-by-week).
- Migration throughput: with the current peering we can sustain ~600 MB/s of cross-region copies during off-peak; that'll move ~2TB/day in practice with verification. For the Acme-sized tenant (500GB), expect 6–12 hours per tenant for full copy+verify.
- Deletion semantics: once TTL is changed to a shorter bucket, mark objects for purge but do not physically delete until a 72-hour grace window and an immutable snapshot is taken (to satisfy legal hold requests).

Related items: JIRA-INF-3421 (routing metadata for tenant-level policies) — we should link Console toggles to that ticket so engineering owners are clear.

Blockers: need confirmation on whether we should expose "clone" vs "move" in the first release. Cloning multiplies storage costs and the billing model needs to be explicit.

I'll be available to join the Wed 3/31 sync and can bring a short runbook for cutover steps.

—Jonas
Staff Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Related links: JIRA-INF-3421, https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Aq-tenant-geo-policy-spec

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sylvia Nguyen <sylvia.nguyen@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 23:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Configurable tenant geo-policy admin UI + migration plan

Thanks — this is helpful and exactly what I needed. Quick decisions to lock before the Wed sync: 
- MVP: preset TTL buckets + gated "custom TTL" requests handled by CS (Marissa).
- Migration mode: bulk snapshot-and-copy for MVP, with streaming backfill as an opt-in for enterprise customers.
- Show both "clone" (for staging) and "move" (for production) in the UI but grey out clone billing details until Finance signs off.
- Enforcement window: 72-hour post-TTL grace with an immutable snapshot retained for 30 days.

Action items:
- Dev: produce a short tech note on snapshot storage and the 30-day immutable retention cost estimate (add to JIRA-INF-3421).
- Jonas: draft the cutover runbook and flag-state transitions; add migration_state enum to the ticket.
- Laura: wire a Console mock that shows the region toggle, TTL selector, and an audit panel. Use the spec PDF for copy.
- Marissa: draft an external communications blurb and the gated approval flow for custom TTLs.

I'll schedule a 30-min sync Wed 3/31 10:00 PT and invite Acme for the demo portion. If anyone has objections to the decisions above, reply-all with concerns before 10:00 PT tomorrow.

—Camila
Senior Product Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: tenant_geo_policy_spec_v2.pdf, migration_steps.xlsx
